structured_output.rationale: All three lines denied CO-29 (timely filing expired) with N211. The 837P in hand is dated 20250330 — over 8 months post-DOS, outside any commercial window. But the 277CA proves an earlier accepted submission on 20240718, 5 days after DOS 20240713, using the same TRC (TRC59398832). That acceptance report is proof the claim was filed timely. Appeal to dispute the payer's receipt date, not to plead forgiveness. N211 does not bar an appeal grounded on a disputed receipt date.

root_cause.explanation: Payer applied CO-29 to the March 2025 resubmission. The 277CA confirms the original claim (TRC59398832) was accepted by the clearinghouse on 20240718 — 5 days after DOS 20240713, well within any commercial limit.

next_action.detail: File a redetermination/appeal attaching the 277CA (STC*A2:20, 20240718) as proof of timely original submission. Dispute payer's receipt date; do not plead forgiveness. N211 does not bar this appeal.

evidence.fact: All three SVC lines carry CAS*CO*29; MOA N211; $0 paid on $156.05 billed.
Original claim TRC59398832 accepted by clearinghouse on 20240718 — 5 days after DOS 20240713.
Resubmission dated 20250330 carries same TRC59398832, confirming this is a later resend of the originally timely claim.
Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with the clearinghouse acceptance report to dispute the receipt date.

citations.rule: Proof of an accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report; dispute the receipt date, don't plead forgiveness.
CARC 29: genuinely late with no exception → do_not_resubmit; but timely proof → appeal.
